name: FINIS Long Floating Fins for beginners
description: The exception to the short-blade rule, and the fin nearly every swimmer starts on. The extra length and float give true beginners the propulsion and flotation to learn the kicking motion.

name: Budget waterproof bone-conduction MP3 headphones
description: The low-risk way to find out whether you like swimming to music. Confirm real onboard storage and an IPX8 rating before you buy, then upgrade later if you get hooked.

name: TYR Junior and Standard Pull Float
description: The one to buy when a standard buoy has always sat wrong. Clearly sized options let you match the float to your body, so it doesn't shove a smaller swimmer too high or leave a bigger swimmer's legs dragging.

name: Sony Sports Walkman with headphones
description: If sound quality is the priority, in-ear wins. The seal inside your ear delivers fuller, bassier audio than bone conduction can.
